data.long_meaning: The name Aldred is derived from Old English, where it means 'old, wise counsel'. This name was popular in Anglo-Saxon England and was often given to children as a symbol of wisdom and maturity. In the Christian tradition, Aldred can be seen as a reflection of the wisdom and guidance offered by God. The name Aldred carries the meaning “Old, wise counsel” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aldred usually hope their child will grow to embody old, wise counsel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
